semantic_summary.one_sentence_summary: The audio contains a free-form ritual vocal pattern characterized by mostly descending pitch contours, a stable tonal center near G3, and repeated melodic motifs with varied phrase durations.
semantic_summary.structure_description: The vocalization consists of 25 phrases, mostly extended with a mean duration around 10.5 seconds, interleaved with 18 pauses of varying lengths. Vocal density is high (~0.92), with a predominance of long and short pauses. Pitch contours within phrases are mostly descending or flat, with an overall descending melodic direction. Six distinct melodic motifs recur throughout the recording, covering over 95% of the phrases.
